{
  "thinking": "My inspection finished, but my earlier call got talked over. Sam has the pad and is laying the dorsal fin, Tom's belly is still queued, and Grace and Maya are closing the nose and the tail. About 3.8 minutes are left, so nobody should push yet.",
  "say": "Sofia here, catching up. I've looked at the lower tail. The pale bottom section is the belly, which isn't down yet. Nobody pushes until Grace calls the nose closed, Maya calls the tail joined, and Tom's belly is standing.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 4,
  "point": [25, 13],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Fish facing left, tail on right, START at top of tail. Stroke 1 back: Leo, reached nose. Stroke 2 belly: Tom, queued, not laid yet; Grace and Hana on standby. Stroke 3 bottom fin: Omar. Stroke 4 tail join: on table; Maya closing the vertical gap under the top, Hana to recheck. Top fin: Priya, inner V done, START joint bridged. Dorsal fin (stroke 6): Sam, laying it now; pad going back to Leo. Eye label on pad. Nose: Grace fixing the off-line domino at the bottom and will call it closed. Lower tail and belly are the pale ~40 not connected to START. I'm off building, watching. Nobody pushes until START is joined, belly is down, and lower tail is connected. About 3.8 min left at 6:15."
